answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The willow is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the marble. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nectar of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
